title: ui_logout
summary: GameLoop.Logout.cs + LogoutUiLaw realize the whole arc: CMSG_LOGOUT_REQUEST on Logout/Exit, the SMSG_LOGOUT_RESPONSE decision table (reason!=0 refused with an error line and quit-disarm; instant silent awaiting completion; else a 20 s camp/quit countdown dialog), CMSG_LOGOUT_CANCEL via ESC or Cancel with SMSG_LOGOUT_CANCEL_ACK teardown, quit-only 'Exit now' force button, countdown expiry that only narrates (never manufactures completion), and SMSG_LOGOUT_COMPLETE either exiting the process (quit) or tearing down to character select. Menu sounds fire on request and dialog show/hide. LogoutUiLaw now owns the unchanged centered 360x96 frame, y=128 seat, countdown center, Camp/Quit button fork, 128x20 child rectangles and cropped button UVs; the ImGui renderer only hosts those law-computed positions. The 2026-08-23 re-review against current Benilla found the same logout contract plus unrelated Reload UI request routing, with no new desktop logout behavior to port.

openItems.text: The logout countdown modal renderer directly assembled its centered frame, message center, Camp/Quit button seats, button sizes and cropped texture UVs.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Moved the unchanged modal and child geometry into LogoutUiLaw. The renderer contains no explicit Vector2 construction; Game Menu-focused and full interface clinical suites pass.

openItems.text: Re-audit the current Benilla logout module after its source fingerprint changed.
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-23: Re-audited the current source. Refusal, instant response, camp/quit countdown, cancellation, force quit and completion semantics remain matched; the added Reload UI routing is unrelated to the logout modal and requires no change here.
